name: KINETIC SEO
summary: AI-powered SEO command center with dashboard analytics, keyword research, landing page, and pricing tiers

KineticHeader.summary: Fixed top navbar for marketing pages: KINETIC branding, route-aware nav links (Features, Solutions, Pricing, Resources), Login button, Get Started gradient CTA. Dark glassmorphism with purple glow.

KineticSidebar.summary: Fixed left sidebar with KINETIC branding, gradient bolt icon, project info, route-aware nav (Overview, Keywords, Landing, Pricing, Backlinks, Competitors, Settings), New Audit CTA, Support/Documentation footer links. Dark theme (#131313 bg).

OverviewContent.summary: Dashboard overview: header with avatars and date filter, 3 KPI glass cards (Site Health 94%, Keywords Ranked 1,284, Organic Traffic 42.5k) with SVG mini-charts, AI Kinetic Insights panel with actionable recommendations, Competitor Pulse sidebar, System Status card, minimal footer.

KeywordsContent.summary: Keyword research: sticky search/filter header, 3 hero metric cards (Rank #4, Volume 842.5K, CPC $12.40), keyword analytics data table with difficulty bars and trend sparklines, pagination, floating AI assistant button, footer.

LandingContent.summary: Marketing landing page: hero with gradient text and CTAs, glass interface preview with SVG chart, Neural Infrastructure 3-feature bento grid, CTA section with radial gradient, 4-column footer.

PricingContent.summary: Pricing page: hero header, 3-tier pricing grid (Basic $49, Pro $149 featured with glow, Enterprise $499) with glass cards, trust section with brand logos, 4-column footer.

theme.summary: Material Symbols icon font class, glass-card and glow-border utility classes with pseudo-element gradient borders, dark theme :host styles, Manrope headline overrides

headTags.content: .material-symbols-outlined{font-family:'Material Symbols Outlined';font-variation-settings:'FILL' 0,'wght' 400,'GRAD' 0,'opsz' 24;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;font-size:24px;display:inline-block;line-height:1;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;word-wrap:normal;white-space:nowrap;direction:ltr;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}.glass-card{background:rgba(26,25,25,0.9);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);position:relative}.glass-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;padding:1px;border-radius:inherit;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(204,151,255,0.4) 0%,transparent 40%);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;pointer-events:none}.ambient-glow{box-shadow:0 0 60px 0 rgba(204,151,255,0.08)}.featured-glow{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(204,151,255,0.15)}.glow-border{border-top:1px solid rgba(204,151,255,0.4);border-left:1px solid rgba(204,151,255,0.2)}
